movie_title: New UK PM is Liz Truss: BBC News Review
introduction: Improve your English listening and vocabulary with the BBC. Liz Truss has taken over from Boris John

vocabulary.definition: voluntarily leave a job or position
vocabulary.example: After the scandal, Boris Johnson resigned as Prime Minister.
The new Prime Minister faces urgent issues like the energy crisis.

vocabulary.definition: a strong supporter of a person, group, or cause
vocabulary.example: Liz Truss was known as a loyalist to Boris Johnson before becoming Prime Minister.

vocabulary.definition: the action or process of inheriting a title or office
vocabulary.example: In the British Royal Family, Prince Charles will succeed Queen Elizabeth II in the line of succession.

vocabulary.definition: using or involving metaphors, not literal language
vocabulary.example: The headline about 'storm clouds gathering' was metaphorical and did not refer to actual weather.

vocabulary.definition: a period of temporary economic decline
vocabulary.example: The Prime Minister is concerned about the possibility of an economic recession following the energy crisis.
